en: A colorized vintage postcard-style view over a hilly town with many trees in bloom. At the top of the hill stand several prominent buildings including a large church with a tall spire and other substantial masonry structures, likely historic civic or religious buildings. Below, clustered townhouses and small industrial buildings fill the valley. A curving path or road runs through a green foreground hillside. The sky is softly tinted blue with scattered clouds. The caption in the upper left reads "Leisnig i. Sa."
